name: paged-event-scans
description: deterministic top pages, offset scans and filtered pages

queries.name: first-page
queries.sql: SELECT event_id, user_id FROM events ORDER BY event_id LIMIT 20

queries.name: offset-page
queries.sql: SELECT event_id, user_id FROM events ORDER BY event_id LIMIT 20 OFFSET 50

queries.name: filtered-page
queries.sql: SELECT event_id, amount FROM events WHERE status = 'paid' ORDER BY event_id LIMIT 20 OFFSET 10
